verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official MCP server (model-context-protocol docs page) that lets any MCP client or AI editor run trends, funnels, retention, SQL queries, ship feature flags, dig into stack traces, and more, with GitHub README confirming steering via MCP alongside Slack/desktop/editor. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability/setup experience and no community corroboration beyond vendor docs.
